purpose: Audio-only Codila sound-layer candidate for the accepted Grifon shader film

selection.hero: A real recorded low thump plus a separate physical tap; no synthesized sub
selection.camera: A visually inspected single whoosh or swish, with no interior clicks or steady noise
selection.material: A short physical tap or click, used only at an authored full-frame material change
selection.ui: A real mouse click or keyboard key, used only at an actual UI/character action
selection.approval: Root must bind selected recordings to CC0 credits, source hashes, OK sidecars and inspected waveform/spectrogram sheets before mixing
